question: Kargil Vijay Diwas is celebrated on ________ every year.
solution:
The correct answer is __**26th July**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kargil Vijay Diwas**__

 __
 
• Every year **26th July** is observed as the **Kargil Vijay Diwas.**
 
• It is in the memory of the recapture of the Kargil hills after defeating the Pakistani troops in the Kargil district in the Ladakh division.
 
• The mission was named 'Operation Vijay' by the Indian Army, while the Air Force named it 'Operation Safed Sagar'.
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Operation Vijay**__

 
 
• In the year **1999,** India and Pakistan signed the **Lahore Agreement** to mutually resolve the Kashmir issue in a peaceful manner.
 
• However, the Pakistani troops began infiltrating toward the Indian side of the Line of Control (LoC) under **Operation Badr**, hoping to cut off Indian Troops in Siachen. 
 
• Indian Army responded by launching **Operation Vijay**.
 
• On **3rd May 1999**, Pakistan started this war when it had infiltrated into the high altitudes in the rocky mountainous region of Kargil with around 5000 soldiers and captured it.
 
• When the Indian Government got the information about it,** ‘Operation Vijay’** was launched by the Indian army to throw back the intruders who had treacherously occupied Indian Territory.
